notes: The supplied OSF file URL resolves to a preregistration manuscript explicitly using simulated Qualtrics data. Those simulated statistics were not used. The completed author preprint was obtained from the registered-from project hw4av, Preprint folder, file hn6xt; its title/authors, original studies and final-result page locators match the assignment. No conversions performed. Where a locator covers action identification and mind attribution, the high-level action-identification test is selected; the other outcome is described in notes. The p. 48 locator is an exploratory table across seven conditions; selected its Control row, independently corroborated by the Study 1 results and Table 8. Main Study 1 prints df 156, whereas p. 48 prints df 168 for a different control correlation (mind attribution × moral status). The exact target analytic n is left null, rather than borrowing that different test’s df or the overall N. Original n is established by explicit recruitment minus one exclusion, consistent with r(48).
